title.narrative: Kenya Fast-start Article 6 Readiness Support Project

description.narrative: This project will support the Ministry of Environment, Climate Change and Forestry (MoECCF), notably under the Climate Change Directorate (CCD) lead, to strengthening Kenya’s Article 6 readiness. This project will focus on the initial short-term support (6 months) and will set up the enabling conditions for the success of a subsequent and longer-termed readiness project for Article 6 operationalization with potential additional support on MAIN origination and transaction allowing the country to meet its mitigation targets while mitigating its risk of overselling.
